identity.title: [v0.91.8][runtime-v3][observability] Integrate tracing with Vector durable master logging

values.summary: Implemented production Runtime v3 tracing through the existing tracing facade into one pinned Vector pipeline, with durable canonical master JSONL, auditor schema for WP-12, startup signal ordering, fail-closed Vector child liveness supervision, span correlation through tracing-subscriber, redaction, bounded buffering/drain behavior, OTLP configuration, and repo-native macOS/Linux/Windows Vector provisioning.
actual_changes: Registered the OS shutdown receiver before control API readiness is exposed and reused it in the serve loop.
Started one long-lived Vector child from an explicit repo-provisioned binary path and exposed fail-closed liveness snapshots.
Replaced the hand-rolled tracing subscriber with tracing-subscriber Registry plus a runtime logging layer.
Added canonical master log records and adl.runtime.master_log_audit.v1 report parsing for WP-12 consumption.
Added native Windows Vector 0.56.0 provisioning with official SHA-256 verification.

actual_validation.purpose: Focused Runtime v3 Vector master-log, auditor, startup signal, fail-closed supervision, tracing correlation, provisioning, and hygiene proof for #5691
actual_validation.evidence_ref: local proof bundle at f8db82cf: observability 9/9 passed with real pinned Vector; configuration 15/15 passed; strict all-target Clippy passed; guardian_soak 7/7 declared ignored passed; cargo fmt --check passed; git diff --check passed; Opus final confirmation result final_status=ok and REVIEW_COMPLETE with no actionable P1/P2.
